purpose: A technical follow-up to two genuine direct-return map refusals. Keep both original stops, task wording, full report requirements, original failed receipts, 240s deadline, model, effort and all route protections. These known branch outcomes belong only to development.
registration: Freeze this protocol and source before fresh measurements. First examine camera registration on the four original calibration images with all source/capture alternatives, plus previous same-family near-pose and hard wrong-site cameras. Then make one new local two-stop round for each original case. Neither failure nor low image quality creates a replacement slot.
return_policy: Try the original direct return first through the native map check. Only after an explicit unknown-space map refusal without any move, use strictly earlier points from the actually recorded outward odometry. Choose the earliest toward home currently admitted by the same current native map. Check each position again through the original mover. Collect points 0.75 m apart using measured snapshots, bounded 30 points. Stop on no admitted point, an attempted move failure, clock exhaustion, or arrival back at the original position and yaw. Save every query, refusal and physical segment.
calibration: Test source orientation using the two supplied camera calibrations and the measured camera poses. A rotation-only reprojection of the source is permissible only if position separation <=0.10 m, relative rotation <=8 degrees, valid image coverage >=0.90 and measured grayscale Pearson correlation >=0.90. Use no hidden texture, rendered pixels or target label for this photometric score. Also retain the v1 raw NCC and renderer and surface evidence thresholds. Report wrong-stop and same-family wrong-site matches, do not use orientation matching to admit when any wrong-stop/wrong-site control passes the photometric and pose criteria. For live admission require the independent visibility/renderer tests, actual full route and either original raw NCC >=0.85 at both stops, or additionally both corrected NCCs pass the separately tested control gate. No scene or acceptance changes based on model replies.
online: If the defined common execution foundation passes calibration, repeat the original registered method order as a new authored development block. Serial and same-information earliest-legal-work each receive independent live runs, max 2 real sends per arm. Collapse only exactly identical policies under the publicly declared order, with no independent score. No conditional second-stop image or field before its particular public grant. Usable inference and route times require actual ledgers. Clear cases never imply positive efficacy; do not launch an independent test.
